input.question: What is the population of Vermillion Township?

documents.text: Vermillion Township, Dakota County, Minnesota Vermillion Township is a township in Dakota County, Minnesota, United States. The population was 1,243 at the 2000 census. Vermillion Township was organized in 1858, and took its name from the Vermillion River. According to the United States Census Bureau, the township has a total area of 34.1 square miles (88.4 km²), all of it land. As of the census of 2000, there were 1,243 people, 395 households, and 325 families residing in the township. The population density was 36.4 people per square mile (14.1/km²).
